title: Lease Term Agreement Rent Change Notice Minimums and Month-to-Month Conversion by Program
content:
Three settings of each Lease Term Agreement program govern rent changes and the end of a fixed term: the company minimum written notice before a rent increase takes effect, whether the rent may change during the term, and whether a term that ends with no renewal and no notice converts automatically to month-to-month.

| Term program | Company minimum notice before a rent increase (calendar days) | Rent may change during the term | Automatic month-to-month conversion at term end |
|---|---|---|---|
| Month-to-Month Agreement | 30 | Yes | Yes |
| Short-Term Lease (3-5 Months) | 45 | No | Yes |
| Flexible Lease (6-9 Months) | 60 | No | Yes |
| Standard Lease (10-12 Months) | 60 | No | Yes |
| Extended Lease (13-15 Months) | 60 | No | Yes |
| Long-Term Lease (16-24 Months) | 60 | No | Yes |

Only the Month-to-Month Agreement allows its rent to change during the term; every fixed-term program holds its rent for the whole term. Every program converts automatically to month-to-month when it ends with no renewal and no notice.

**Points of reading.** The notice minimum is a company figure in calendar days; for a month-to-month agreement it is 30 days. A Flexible Lease (6-9 Months) term shows No in the mid-term column, so its rent holds from its first to its last day.
